text:
Alex: FYI, noticed a bunch of broken intra-doc anchors in staging after the sanitizer change. Links with encoded chars (`#terms%3Ausage`, `#what%20is`) now sometimes fail to jump.
Priya: I reproduced. The new frontend is URL-decoding fragments before we compare to generated heading IDs — that breaks our slugifier which turns spaces and colons into `-`.
Jordan: I pushed a small patch that runs incoming fragment through the same slugify function before matching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501. It also adds unit tests for `slugify('#Terms: Usage')` -> `terms-usage`.
Elena: Nice. While debugging I found an unrelated mkdocs build error: code fence inside a nested list in `docs/tutorials/embedding-guide.md` is missing a blank line before the fence so parser chokes. I'll open a cleanup PR.
Priya: Can we also fix a few `![ ](img.png)` empty alt placeholders? Linkcheck flags them and some screenreader lints fail. I can tidy those in the same PR as the fence fix.
Alex: Prefer bundling the markdown whitespace + alt fixes into one PR to avoid repeated linkcheck runs. Jordan, do you want your slugify PR separate since it touches the frontend router?
Jordan: Yes, separate please. Frontend change needs a small integration test and a changelog entry. I also added a rollback guard: if slug mapping mismatches, we fallback to attempting exact-decoded match for legacy links.
Elena: Opening PR 502 for markdown reflow + alt text now. Will include the specific file diffs and a short note in the PR description referencing the failing buildkite job.
DocsBot: buildkite/docs-site #912 failed — mkdocs linkcheck 14 warnings, 2 errors. Logs: <link>.
Alex: Queue: Jordan PR 501 (fragment normalization + tests), Elena PR 502 (markdown fence + alt text). After both merge I'll kick linkcheck CI.
Priya: Quick review pointers: for PR 501, please add a small comment about preserving existing external anchor behavior (don't alter absolute URLs). For PR 502, ensure code block fencing follows the mkdocs recommended pattern inside lists (blank line before backticks).
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll add tests for absolute URL passthrough and update PR description.
Elena: PR 502 created: includes fixes in `embedding-guide.md`, `quickstart.md`, and `assets/diagram-setup.png` alt text.
Alex: Thanks team. Once CI passes, we should draft a short migration note for customers linking into our docs using raw decoded fragments. Might be a 1-sentence note in the changelog.
DocsBot: PR 501 CI: pending, PR 502 CI: running.
